description: WHEN: the user asks whether a feature is tested and what the results are: 'is WI N tested', 'where are we on the tests', 'état des tests de la story', 'what failed'. Lists the test cases tied to a work item with their latest outcome in its test plan suite (Passed, Failed, Blocked, Not run) and a summary. Read only. Pass planId when you know it (ado_create_test_plan returns it); otherwise the plan named 'Tests - WI {id} ...' is looked for. A test case that is not in any suite of the plan shows as 'not in the plan'.

project.description: Azure DevOps project. Falls back to DEVOPS_PROJECT.

workItemId.description: Work item the tests verify, e.g. 6587.

name: ado_test_status
